title: Auto Loans: which late charge and which autopay debit are examined for a bank-error waiver
content:
# Auto Loans: which late charge and which autopay debit are examined for a bank-error waiver

This rule of the Auto Loans product category at PCB applies when a late charge on an auto loan is examined as a possible PCB error arising from an autopay debit presented to a closed account. It fixes which late charge and which debit are read.

## Clauses

1. **The late charge.** The late charge considered is the most recent late charge on the loan, by posting date. Its installment is the installment due date that late charge was charged on.
2. **The debit.** The debit is the latest autopay payment (an autopay debit from a PCB checking account) credited toward that installment due date.
3. **Returned or not.** The debit counts as returned when a payment reversal names it as the payment returned.
4. **What is read from the debit.** Its posting date and its paying account (the checking account it was drawn on) are read from that payment.

## Reading order

1. Take the late charge with the latest posting date and note its installment due date.
2. Among autopay payments credited toward that installment due date, take the latest.
3. Check whether any payment reversal names that debit.
4. Note the debit's posting date and paying account.

## Worked case (hypothetical loan activity)

| Entry | Posted | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| Late charge L | 2026-05-21 | on the installment due 2026-05-05 |
| Autopay payment D1 | 2026-05-05 | credited toward 2026-05-05, drawn on checking account K |
| Payment reversal R | 2026-05-08 | names D1 |

The late charge examined is L; the debit examined is D1, posted 2026-05-05 on account K; D1 counts as returned because reversal R names it.

## Contrast

| Variation | Effect on what is read |
|---|---|
| The latest payment toward 2026-05-05 was a PCB transfer, not an autopay debit | the debit is still the latest autopay payment toward that date |
| No payment reversal names D1 | D1 does not count as returned |
